notes.title: Doom co-creator finally plays the best boomer shooter: "son, you did a good job"
notes.content:
If we were to put it to a democratic vote, the people would undoubtedly elect Doom as their boomer shooter president. But is it the best? Many would argue that title belongs to Dusk, the 2018, retro-style FPS that feels like a throw back to the golden age of Doom. Built primarily by just one man, it's one of the best-reviewed boomer shooters ever, and one of the highest-rated by Steam users. Now though, it's received the ultimate praise. John Romero, the co-founder of id Software and designer of the first Doom game, has finally got around to playing it - and he loves it.

notes.title: DUSK HD + SDK Update
notes.content:
[h3]Welcome back once again...

Today we bring an update for all the [b]WORTHY[/b] playing DUSK in 2024.

Updates to both the [b]DUSK SDK[/b] and [b]DUSK HD[/b] (with more soon to come)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/6d53b960da829c3fa71baa864c8c85a06a1c5a13.png[/img]

The [b]DUSK SDK[/b] is getting a sizeable update today! With better Quake and Half Life map support as well as the ability to make [b]ENDLESS LEVELS[/b], fixing some major bugs and advanced music scripting!

[u][h2]New Entities[/h2][/u]
[h3]info_playlist[/h3]
Creates a music playlist. Give this entity a targetname, and assign a sequence of music tracks by setting track0, track1, and so on to music file paths.

[h3]trigger_playlist[/h3]
Activates a music playlist. Set the target to the targetname of an info_playlist entity, then trigger the trigger_playlist in order to begin playback. You can set shuffle to 1 to enable shuffling of the playlist, and loop to 1 to cause the playlist to loop. When a playlist is looping, you can use a 
trigger_changemusic trigger to stop it.

[h3]point_template[/h3]
Used for creating enemy templates that are later spawned with a trigger. Refer to the Source point_template documentation for further details. DUSK additionally supports specifying teleportfx 1 to spawn teleporter particles on each enemy spawned.

[h3]info_endless_node[/h3]
This entity will trigger its target when a new wave begins, if the current wave is greater than or equal to its first_wave property. The last_wave property can be used to disable an info_endless_node starting from a specific wave.

[h3]trigger_remove_target[/h3]
This entity will immediately delete any entities it is targeting when it is triggered. 

[code][h3]You can now create Custom endless maps by setting endless to 1 in worldspawn 

Enemy template entities also require an endless property set to 1 on them in order to be tracked as endless wave enemies [/h3][/code]
[u][h2]Fixes/Changes[/h2][/u][list]

[*]  Fixed memory leak when finishing a custom level
[*] Fixed fence texture rendering for embedded BSP textures

notes.title: DUSK HD + SDK & Steam Workshop OUT NOW
notes.content:
[h3][b]Five years.[/b]

It's been five long years since we launched DUSK v1.0[/h3]

[i]Even longer than that if you count Early Access and the two years of development that started in 2016.[/i]

And throughout all that time, we always promised to make DUSK as open and moddable for you as we possibly can.

But what we [i]didn't[/i] promise you was a full remaster of the game only 5 years after its release. [b]And that's what we've somehow done.[/b] What started as a fun way to beef up the DUSK Steam Workshop soon evolved into a full blown visual remaster thanks to the hard work of a group of very talented developers at New Blood under the supervision of David Szymanski, myself (Dave), our QA Lead Cam, Dev Support Lead Scott, and the rest of the New Blood crew. And the result? is[b] DUSK HD[/b]

[previewyoutube=kQx2QCmZruw;full][/previewyoutube]
The response to [b]DUSK HD[/b] has been bigger than we ever could have possibly imagined. So much so that we've decided to make it into [b]its own FREE DLC[/b] that you can download and play without having to install anything else... [b]RIGHT NOW.[/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2717300/DUSK_HD][img]https://i.imgur.com/oCanrbj.png[/img][/url]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2717300/DUSK_HD/

[i]Go ahead, prove yourself... WORTHY.[/i]

What that also means is that we've spent the last few months working overtime on DUSK HD to make sure it's as legitimate and cohesive and possible. Constantly iterating, tweaking and adding new things every day. [i]It rules. We hope you love it.
[/i]
[b]HOWEVER[/b]

While DUSK has indeed been somewhat moddable and mappable for years - Shout out to DUSKmods.com - we've always envisioned a world in which DUSK was just as moddable as DOOM and and the other classics that inspired us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/7f45493e64ae055591b8c4f7f7bea652e1d6da50.jpg[/img]
We knew that undertaking would be massive, requiring us to basically rewrite the entire game and engine from scratch (which we have) but here we are, closing in on a decade of development, with the full DUSK DDK (Dusk Development Kit) [b]ALMOST[/b] ready for you to use.

That's right, while [b]DUSK HD and the basic SDK and Steam Workshop are indeed AVAILABLE FOR YOU NOW.[/b] [u]The Full Dusk Development Kit built upon the new version of DUSK is still a few weeks away.[/u]

[b]What does that mean?[/b]

[i]Well, DUSK HD is playable now and the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/519860/workshop/]Steam Workshop[/url] is fully functional![/i]

[quote][b]You can:[/b]

Make and play custom maps, (even basically drag and drop Quake and Half Life maps) use texture replacements and sound replacements. [u]Plus every file from the base game is available for you to use.[/u]

[b]You cannot:[/b]

Have custom models (enemies), entities, weapons, and nothing from the HD pack is available for you to use yet.[/quote]
Once the FULL SDK built on the new version of DUSK is available SOON™ you will be able to play all the custom maps with both Classic or HD visuals, replace weapons, models and more.

Speaking of which, we've added a new weapon to the game :)

[previewyoutube=kZ6dZL38f3Y;full][/previewyoutube][i](It shares slot 7 with the crossbow)[/i]

Oh and [b]DUSK - Moddable[/b] will even detect any installed games with compatible assets and allow you to seamlessly load their maps. Thanks, Garry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/22a90bd9c9de066422b3a4f224dba65a9f4e6a62.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/2b54f3fe3eaab9116aa8aa3341bfc5ac7e5b88d9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/bde78c82d0f4ca3480997fbc3ff978cc1fca1422.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/7ca0fad1c5e9df4c81c2d2472135db4aa14e55a4.jpg[/img]
This massive undertaking has been the work of primarily two of our developers.

Ben "Zombie" Moir has been rewriting DUSK from the ground up for nearly 5 years and David "Garumin" Bonin has remade every single visual asset from DUSK by hand over the last two years as well as creating all new ones to add to DUSK HD.

And unbeknownst to them, [b]all the profits from DUSK for the month of December 2023 will be split between David and Ben.[/b]  [i]Don't spend it all in one place, lads.[/i]

The entirely new enemy and weapon models were made by our 3D artist Cody Lambert and all the new animations you see were made by our animators Dom Antonazzo and Lachlan Milne.

These developers all started out as external contractors for us and [i]because of DUSK HD they are now full time New Blood employees working across all our games.[/i] [b]WELCOME TO THE CULT.[/b]

[url=https://twitter.com/tat2kid714][img]https://i.imgur.com/lcuIOGH.png[/img][/url]

All that being said... if you, dear reader, are playing DUSK for the first time, fifth time, or 500th time...

We hope it helps you realize a few things.

[b]Firstly:[/b] We love you and we hate money.

[b]Secondly:[/b] We work hard.

[h3][b]And lastly:[/b] There's only one... [i]DUSK[/i][/h3]

notes.title: DUSK 2021
notes.content:
[i][h3][b]WELCOME BACK.[/b][/h3][/i]
In our never ending quest to keep updating [i]DUSK[/i] until the end of existence... we come to you today with an update to the current game... and a look at what's yet to come in the [b]Year of Our Eldritch Lords 2021[/b]

First off, let's go over what's in [b]THIS[/b] small update we just pushed.

[i][h3][b]Save deletion![/b][/h3][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/ee12dab0bffbf25cc1062a1d5efcd7051c3c3815.gif[/img]

[b]Finally[/b], you can delete your [i]DUSK[/i] saves in-game. [b]Sorry it took us 3 years to add this feature.[/b] There's also neat new icons so we don't have to localize the words SAVE / LOAD / DELETE into more languages!

[i]Next up...[/i]

[i][h3][b]A CONTINUE button![/b][/h3][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/de78cad91ca190b93539a08719e695f8a7bbec43.png[/img]

As you may remember, [i]DUSK[/i] was released episodically throughout 2017 / 2018. So in order to start a [b]NEW[/b] episode you had to go [i]back[/i] to the main menu after you beat [i]every[/i] episode.

Well [b]NOT ANY MORE[/b]. Now you can play right through all 3 episodes of [i]DUSK[/i] without ever having to stop!

Go on, try it... [b][i]taste the continuity.[/i][/b]

[i]And finally...[/i]

[i][h3][b]a MAX LOADOUT button.[/b][/h3][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/1d9a596ace3815252c403be2f15816ae907bd085.gif[/img]

For when you want to start a level with [b]MAXIMUM[/b] firepower. But less button clicking.

[h3][b]So that's what in the game NOW.[/b][/h3]

[i]However... [/i]

As part of our Switch port ([url=https://twitter.com/DaveOshry/status/1376705881811877889]which is totally almost finished we swear[/url]) we've completely redone the world map and loadout menus to be easier to read and navigate with a controller, keyboard, mouse and eyes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/776e7f06833e2aba6511575e438672346a3afaa0.gif[/img]

[i]And when we release those versions of the game? [/i]

[h3]We'll be [u]simultaneously[/u] bringing the features from consoles (like that [b]new world menu[/b] and the [b]weapon wheel[/b]) [u]back[/u] to the PC version.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/84628526cc93fec92c3e4989bdba60c66921d9e2.gif[/img]

As well as the [b]Classic HUD[/b] we've shown off and been promising to you for so long.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/c9390cbd81d880be60b8d25922270c6f41757b69.png[/img]

[i]I think we already told you this but anyway... yeah![/i]

[h3][b]So look forward to it... SOON™[/b][/h3]

The final version of the [b]DUSK SDK[/b] (and [b]Steam Workshop[/b]) with full support for [i]new enemies, weapons and literally everything else[/i] is still on its way. (With co-op to follow later) 

[i]Because we basically rebuilt the entire game to be 100% moddable at this point.[/i]

And for those of you who aren't waiting for [b]Steam Workshop[/b] support to get into [i]DUSK[/i] modding? 

[h3]Don't forget to check out the latest at [url=https://dusk.mod.io/]DUSKMods.com[/url][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/e60380a62c78fc087f02070e983802f8c408d692.png[/img]

[i][b][h3]Including *7* new maps from the [url=https://dusk.mod.io/dusk-spring-2021-map-jam]DUSK Spring 2021 Map Jam[/url]![/h3][/b][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/9d1cc37ec6e6af38b9b0736dd678ea06c4bd9398.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/acd1776b86f1f386ab1b8ba01181a3e4b8838ea2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/813a236743070544e7eaa7ba56dcd3e6b21ab8b2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26345927/069cb8777ca8f83fbf27c0241fb27a6b8b3a64f3.jpg[/img]

That's right, thanks to our work on the Nintendo Switch™ verison of DUSK ([url=https://twitter.com/DaveOshry/status/1319821845307113473]which we just delayed, sorry[/url]) we've been making lots of performance improvements to DUSK.

[*]Fixed health and armor being incorrect after loading a save on a custom level.

[*]Cartdogs no longer spawn without a model.
[*]Wendigos now correctly spawn invisible.
[*]Missing models will now display as a cube.
[*]Idle animations in custom models will now play correctly.
[*]Added a -skip-dos launch option to skip the FakeDOS intro screen.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused music (and possibly other assets) to occasionally fail to load.
[*]Significantly reduced texture allocations when atlasing lightmap data, resulting in faster map loads and better performance.
[/list]
[b][i]And YES, Custom weapons, Steam Workshop and Co-Op are still coming.[/i][/b]

In addition to that, some things we've added to the console version [b](like the weapon wheel[/b]) will be making it back to the PC Version... SOON™

notes.title: The weird and wonderful voids of video games
notes.content:
Video game worlds are facades, and sometimes we catch a glimpse of what's beyond. Recently, while exploring one of the intricate levels of Dusk, I somehow managed to slip through the cracks and found myself on the other side of the invisible partition that upholds the illusion of coherent space. I'd entered a world of broken, gravity-defying architecture, and there in the middle of the level had opened a pit that revealed a vast grey void beneath my feet. Close by, there was an exasperated message on the ground: "YOU AREN'T SUPPOSED TO BE HERE, GO AWAY."

Anyone who's spent a lot of time playing games will have their own stories of discovering the cordoned-off spaces behind spaces. We know the strange feeling of clipping through the ground only to plunge into a bottomless void while the level we've been exploring recedes into the distant ether above us; a tiny island unto itself, a dwindling speck suspended in the great digital void.

These are accidents and glitches, but then again, if we're not supposed to gaze into the abyss, then why is the void such a popular trope in games? It seems any self-respecting fantasy game offers its players a tour of the void: There's the Void of the Dishonored games (read more about it here), the Fade of the Dragon Age series, the Realm Between Realms of God of War (2018). Divinity: Original Sin 2 and Pillars of Eternity 2: Deadfire also dip their toes into the great nothingness. These are metaphysical spaces inhabited by or associated with gods and spirits, the afterlife, and, most significant of all, origins and acts of creation. They are displaced and timeless, existing in between or beyond conventional space-time, and are only accessible through special pathways that pierce the veil: dreams, visions, rituals, death or magic.

notes.title: The impossible architecture of video games
notes.content:
There is a saying in architecture that no building is unbuildable, only unbuilt. Structures may be impossible in the here and now, but have the potential to exist given enough time or technological development: a futuristic cityscape, a spacefaring megastructure, the ruins of an alien civilisation. However, there are also buildings that defy the physical laws of space. It is not an issue that they could not exist, but that they should not. Their forms bend and warp in unthinkable ways; dream-like structures that push spatial logic to its breaking point.

The Tomb of Porsena is a legendary monument built to house the body of an Etruscan king. 400 years after its construction, the Roman scholar Varro gave a detailed description of the ancient structure. A giant stone base rose 50 feet high, beneath it lay an "inextricable labyrinth", and atop it sat five pyramids. Above this was a brass sphere, four more pyramids, a platform and then a final five pyramids. The image painted by Varro, one of shapes stacked upon shapes, seems like a wild exaggeration. Despite this, Varro's fanciful description sparked the imaginations of countless architects over the centuries. The tomb was an enigma, and yet the difficulty in conceptualising it, and the vision behind it, was fascinating. On paper artists were free to realise its potential. If paper liberated minds, the screen can surely open up further possibilities. There's no shortage of visionary structures within the virtual spaces of video games. These are strange buildings that ask us to imagine worlds radically different to our own.

Whilst many impossible formulations are orientated towards the future, there are also plenty from the past. The castle in Ico is one example of this. During the Renaissance, Europe was obsessed, not with future utopias, but with ancient Greece and Rome. While the box art of Ico is famously inspired by Giorgio de Chirico, the long shadows and sun-bleached stone walls only make-up a portion of the game's mood. It is the etchings of Giovanni Piranesi that best capture what it's like to explore the castle's winding stairs and bridges. Piranesi's imaginary Roman reconstructions were absurdly big - so colossal you could get lost in just the foundations. In a similar way, Ico's castle is impossibly large, the camera zooming out in order to overwhelm you and build up the unfathomable mystery of its origin and purpose.

notes.title: When level design goes awry
notes.content:
Years ago, I interviewed a level designer who had originally trained as an architect, which these days is not an uncommon career trajectory. I asked him about the benefits his skillset brought to 3D level design. He talked about how it helped with approaching scale and structural integrity and creating a rational space.

Then I asked him about what the personal benefits of creating virtual building were. "If you design a building in a game and it falls down," came his simple response, "it cannot kill anyone, and you don't go to prison."

It was a pragmatic reply from a pragmatic person. But underneath it is another meaning - you can build anything you want. In virtual 3D space, the laws of physics don't apply unless you tell them to, and that means you can design any structure that you like.

notes.title: The Dance of DEATH
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1P05qO2P1ybXJ11uuj/giphy.gif[/img]
[h1][b]It comes for us all, you know.[/b][/h1] 

[i]One way or another...[/i]

[b]Be it by sickle, by sword, by shotgun... [i]or by old age while waiting for Episode 3.[/i][/b]

And now... more than ever - [b]BY PROJECTILE[/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/51Un5Kwlyqx4ZXYuGh/giphy.gif[/img]

That's right - the latest [i]DUSKWorld[/i] update FINALLY brings client side projectile fixes making the Mortar, Riveter and Crossbow not only viable MP weapons... but some of the best. 

Why the best? [i]Because we also nerfed the SSG.[/i] Sorry not sorry.

We've also completely overhauled [i]Vestibule & Dusk of the Dead.[/i] 

Vestibule even has [b]TEXTURES[/b] now. Woah...

[h1]Spectate mode now occurs on death![/h1] 
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/X7ZwOfStUAUcwmTE8W/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]Press LMB to switch between players if you get tired of stalking the guy who killed you...[/i]

[h1]The Welder has joined the fray! He's big! He's fat! He's got a welder's mask on![/h1]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/BCdkujL40WgXDpJ7wO/giphy.gif[/img]

With this latest update you'll find that [i]DUSKWorld[/i] is not only more solid and polished but more [b]BALANCED[/b] as well. SO HAVE AT IT. Now more than ever it's the best time to join the fight. We've even got new LFG channels in Discord.gg/NewBlood ... JOIN US.

And since it IS the Steam Summer Sale - we went ahead and finally added trading cards, emotes and backgrounds! (They should be live SOON) Based on the art from the upcoming [i]DUSK[/i] comic - we think they're all very unique and a fine addition to any Steam collection. Happy hunting.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26345927/c95893518653f0d70eda8776b4d7d4c0532d2e78.png[/img]

[h1]And as for what's next?[/h1]

Well, as we wrap up Episode 3 we'll be bringing the entire game into Unity 2018, revamping all of the in-game menus and options, adding achievements, maybe a in-game codex filled with dank lore? and much much more. Team DUSKmatch? Team DUSKmatch.

Oh and did we mention DUSK is coming to Nintendo Switch? That's pretty cool, right? https://twitter.com/TheNewBloods/status/1006578451652886528

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26345927/7c1917e5261b9fc70d442fa73e1384899a47787c.jpg[/img]

And as for Episode 3 itself? [i]Are you sure you want to know?[/i]

[h1][b]Hello again, friends...[/b][/h1]

Over the last week+ since [i]Duels at Dusk 2[/i] we've released an update + several hotfixes for [i]DUSK![/i]

[i]The major changes include...[/i]

*The [b]NEW[/b] sword! (In SP and coming SOON™ to MP)

The sword is now faster, beefier + can not only do a (silent) charged attack with more than 100hp...
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/to3E7h2pgRlTuhr3yW/giphy.gif[/img] 
but can [b]ALSO[/b] now [u]block/reflect[/u] when you have more than 50 morale. [b]Go try it out![/b]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3oo6kwqfzRDpVuxp7v/giphy.gif[/img]

There's now a player death animation and [b]GAME OVER[/b] screen in both Campaign and Endless that will show you how many kills and secrets you got. [i]mmm that's nice.[/i]
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/NewOldKiwi-size_restricted.gif[/img]

And don't forget there's now sweet sickle icons for completing all the awards in a level! Are you... [b]UNHOLY?![/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26345927/04c5079ff1d1f30025fe626f26c32229831d29e4.png[/img]

[b]MOST IMPORTANTLY[/b] - there's now buttons on the main menu to get to [i]DUSKWorld[/i] from [i]DUSK[/i] and vice versa (as well as a New Blood website button for that sweet sweet upcoming merchandise)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26345927/73be97f67ea452801167740f4ea7beee04e3d370.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Now onto [i]DUSKWorld[/i][/b][/h1]

[i]Music in DUSKWorld?![/i]

That's right - you can now bang your head to the sweet sounds of Andrew Hulshult while you get killed by a guy with the SSG (nerf inc) for the 4th time in a row :Lorelei:
https://youtu.be/ztXCawRKcLg
*[b]Spectator Mode![/b]* (alpha)

You can now spectate games with the ~ console! 
[i](to spectate, use "team 0", to rejoin the game, use "team 1")[/i] 

[i]This feature is currently alpha and we'll soon allow you to spectate on death and in first person[/i] :Lorelei:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26345927/7adff3dfd060e471229ce19acf81b13ff631121f.jpg[/img]

*A [b]NEW[/b] map! (Dusk of the Dead)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26345927/004db98dcc86c3b1c25b26a650ee7e9d23686f09.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26345927/21e7d8e266f114cb5836499e09175123d3f91122.png[/img]
[i]You may recognize this map as a rework of E1M7 Dead of the Night[/i]

*A [b]NEW[/b] playable character! (Wendigo)
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3kHArEeiymD4flfLXF/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]Because the only thing scarier than a Wendigo? Is a Wendigo with a shotgun.[/i]

There's a lot of other changes and updates such as chat window fixes and the [b]ability to force colors on other players[/b] (You're welcome, Profanum) so check it all out with the [b]FULL[/b] patch notes here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/519860/discussions/0/1474222499229643131/

We're going to be updating both [i]DUSK[/i] and [i]DUSKWorld[/i] more frequently as we get ever closer to [i]DUSK[/i] v1.0 so stay tuned.

notes.title: DUSK is a delicious cocktail of nineties shooters
notes.content:
A lot of people are comparing DUSK to Quake. They’re not wrong to do that; there are enough brown polygons and chunky weapons to bring back memories of nailguns, ogres and Trent Reznor’s ominous drones.

My mind turned to Blood though. DUSK begins with b-movie horror tropes as chainsaws whirr and cultists shriek threats, and from there it takes a tour through pretty much the whole of nineties shooters, as I remember them.

notes.title: Grungy retro FPS Dusk hits Early Access on January 11th
notes.content:
Update: To clarify, if you buy the game now you’ll receive access to episode 1 & 2 immediately, although the episode 2 launch isn’t officially happening until January 11th, when everything moves to Early Access.

Between Devil Daggers, Strafe, and the seeming eternal renaissance of Quake & Doom modding, it feels like gaming as a whole has come to terms with the idea that 90s FPS design wasn’t an evolutionary point that we’ve moved past so much as its own genre, which many are still experimenting with to this day.

One of the most promising of this fresh wave of neo-retro shooters is Dusk from solo developer David Szymanski and published by New Blood Interactive. The game had already impressed many critics with its first episode (available to play now if you preorder), and as of January 11th, the second act of the game will officially launch as the game transitions into Early Access.

(more…)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26345927/b4ee4784c7f1515546ed3c069abdb173a5986505.jpg[/img]
[b][i]T'was the night before DUSKmas[/i]
[i]And as you might know – DUSK isn't coming this year anymore.[/i]
[i]Alas we are sorry - an actual delay - since at one point we did say it would be that way![/i][/b]

Anyway, enough of the rhymes -  we're sorry but not [b]TOO[/b] sorry. Because we bring good news...

[h1][i]DUSK: Episode 2[/i] is [u][b]DONE[/b][/u] and [i]DUSKWorld[/i] Multiplayer (as you should know) is currently in a very stable and fun closed beta. And we want to give them both to you. ALL of you. ASAP[/h1]

But SOON™  isn't soon enough anymore. In fact, Valve called me a couple of weeks ago ([i]yeah they do that[/i]) and asked what all this SOON™ nonsense was about. It was only [i]kinda[/i] awkward.

So, after explaining to them where we were at in development and our plans for releasing the rest of the game, [b]they suggested the best course of action was to put [i]DUSK[/i] in Early Access.[/b]

Now, after discussing it with the team and our community, we're going to be doing just that.

[h1][b]DUSK will be entering Early Access on January 11th, 2018.[/b][/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26345927/ab41a54020da9211a4582487c38778e17d3ff8e4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: THANK YOU.
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xT9Igjkrt4OFVVqJLa/giphy.gif[/img]

DuskDudes & Dudettes,

      It's now been just about two months since we welcomed you to [i]DUSK[/i].

And the response has been, to put it lightly, [b]OVERHWHELMING.[/b]

We feel overwhelmingly beloved and universally accepted by [b]YOU[/b]. 

The very people who we've been making this game for.

But this was no accident... 

[i]DUSK[/i] (and the reception to it) is the result of the tireless work of the New Blood QA team and the consistent communication with the New Blood community.

And you [b]know[/b], we originally wanted to put out Episode 1 [i]MONTHS[/i] ago.

But we wanted it to be [b]ready[/b].
We wanted to [b]make sure[/b] it was ready.
To make sure it was [b]everything[/b] you expected it to be and everything [b]we[/b] wanted it to be.

And if the response is any indication... then it is just [b]that[/b].

And now, after a damn near [b]universally positive[/b] response from our family, friends, the critics, the lurkers and [b]YOU[/b] - we are finally, completely 100% confident that [i]DUSK[/i] is not only worth your time, but your money. 

But... [b]THIS IS ONLY THE BEGINNING.[/b]

The expectations are higher than ever...
But thanks to [i]your[/i] support, we're more [b]committed[/b] than ever to exceeding them yet again.

[b]YOU[/b] are the reason this game is what it is.
[b]YOU[/b] are the reason we wake up every day and [i]want[/i] to read the comments.

And [b]YOU[/b] are proof that if a game developer sets out to make the game they say they're going to make, and communicates with their players honestly from day one?
 
Then the world [b]can[/b] in fact be all sunshine and rainbows and rockets and shotguns.

So... to the  thousands of players in the New Blood community already knee deep in [i]DUSK[/i], and the tens of thousands waiting for the full game and beyond...

We just wanted to say, 

[b]THANK YOU.[/b]

[i]Dave, David, Andrew and the New Blood family[/i] [b]<3[/b]


P.S. hup hup... hup hup hup... SOON™
